notes: Atrium v0.9.0 — Editions & Worktrees: a git-worktree lens for the Sidebar (each worktree as a two-line row, empty worktrees as launch targets, drift detection, move-to-worktree; bare-clone and traditional layouts, graceful on non-git repos), plus the developer foundation for the Free/Pro editions (a build-time isPro() seam, the MCP server as a Pro-only module, free/pro build modes guarded in CI). Includes the new privacy policy — provable no-telemetry, no backend the app depends on. Windows/WSL2 build; native macOS/Linux still in progress.
